es: Resolver una situación real de llegada a una ciudad extranjera: hacer contactos, negociar un alquiler con condiciones y reparar un malentendido.

usesVocabulary: get off on the wrong foot

vocabulary.en: get off on the wrong foot

teaching.en: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour a follow-up question about the best market, and that helped me to settle in.
teaching.es: Como recién llegado, le hice a mi vecino una pregunta de seguimiento sobre el mejor mercado, y eso me ayudó a instalarme.
teaching.explanationEs: Hacer contactos: retoma lo que dice el otro con una pregunta de seguimiento. Newcomer = recién llegado.
segments: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour a follow-up question about
the best market, and that helped me to settle in.
teaching.audioText: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour a follow-up question about the best market, and that helped me to settle in.

teaching.en: Good morning, Mr Reid, I am writing to the landlord about the flat on Elm Street, which I would like to visit this week.
teaching.es: Buenos días, le escribo al casero por el departamento de la calle Elm, que me gustaría visitar esta semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Primer contacto con el casero (landlord): registro formal y motivo claro en la primera frase.
segments: Good morning, Mr Reid, I am writing to the landlord about the
flat on Elm Street, which I would like to visit this week.
teaching.audioText: Good morning, Mr Reid, I am writing to the landlord about the flat on Elm Street, which I would like to visit this week.

teaching.en: I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent stays at 600 a month for the first year.
teaching.es: Puedo pagar la fianza ahora, siempre que el alquiler se mantenga en 600 al mes durante el primer año.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that + presente simple: condición clara; no se usa will después. Rent = alquiler.
segments: I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent
stays at 600 a month for the first year.
teaching.audioText: I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent stays at 600 a month for the first year.

teaching.en: I will pay three months in advance in exchange for a lower rent, which seems a fair compromise for both of us.
teaching.es: Pagaré tres meses por adelantado a cambio de un alquiler más bajo, lo que me parece un compromiso justo para ambos.
teaching.explanationEs: In exchange for = a cambio de: propones un trueque, no solo pides. A fair compromise: ambos ceden algo.
segments: I will pay three months in advance in exchange for a
lower rent, which seems a fair compromise for both of us.
teaching.audioText: I will pay three months in advance in exchange for a lower rent, which seems a fair compromise for both of us.

teaching.en: A landlord who seems to drive a hard bargain may still strike a deal if you offer something in return.
teaching.es: Un casero que parece negociar con dureza aún puede cerrar un trato si le ofreces algo a cambio.
teaching.explanationEs: Drive a hard bargain = negociar con dureza; strike a deal = cerrar un trato.
segments: A landlord who seems to drive a hard bargain may
still strike a deal if you offer something in return.
teaching.audioText: A landlord who seems to drive a hard bargain may still strike a deal if you offer something in return.

teaching.en: If we get off on the wrong foot, I will clarify what I meant and clear up a misunderstanding without blaming anyone.
teaching.es: Si empezamos con mal pie, aclararé lo que quise decir y resolveré un malentendido sin culpar a nadie.
teaching.explanationEs: Clarify + what I meant: aclaras sin culpar. There was a misunderstanding reparte la responsabilidad; «you misunderstood» acusa.
segments: If we get off on the wrong foot, I will clarify
what I meant and clear up a misunderstanding without blaming anyone.
teaching.audioText: If we get off on the wrong foot, I will clarify what I meant and clear up a misunderstanding without blaming anyone.

prompt.es: ¿Qué pregunta de seguimiento retoma lo que dijo la vecina?

choices.text: Where is the best market around here?
I moved here last week, and I miss my dog.
Which part of the river do you miss most?

feedback.es: Retomar «the evening walks along the river» y pedir más detalle es una pregunta de seguimiento. Cambiar a los mercados o hablar de uno mismo corta el tema de la vecina.

hint.es: Busca la pregunta que usa algo que acaba de decir la vecina.

origin.text: Neighbour: I moved here from Seville two years ago, and I still miss the evening walks along the river.

prompt.es: Completa: «Puedo pagar la fianza ahora, siempre que bajes el alquiler a 650.»

feedback.es: Provided that (o providing that) introduce una condición en una negociación y se construye con presente simple.

hint.es: Es el participio que introduce una condición y va seguido de that.

origin.text: The landlord wants 700 a month, and Carlos cannot quite afford it. He says: I can pay the deposit now, ___ that you lower the rent to 650.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase repara el malentendido sin culpar al otro?

choices.text: I think there was a misunderstanding: I meant the second floor, so let me clarify.
You are wrong, because I never mentioned any floor at all.
It is not my fault; you simply did not listen to me properly.

feedback.es: Hablar de «a misunderstanding» y aclarar lo que querías decir repara sin acusar. Las otras dos niegan o culpan a la otra persona.

hint.es: Repara sin culpar: no empieces la frase con «tú».

origin.text: Landlord: You told me the flat was on the first floor, and I have already asked the cleaners to prepare it.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Puedo ofrecer una fianza mayor a cambio de un contrato más corto.»

answer.text: I can offer a bigger deposit in exchange for a shorter contract
accepted: I can offer a bigger deposit in exchange for a shorter contract
In exchange for a shorter contract I can offer a bigger deposit

feedback.es: In exchange for introduce lo que recibes a cambio de tu oferta: un shorter contract por un bigger deposit.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo negocia Carlos.

choices.text: He warns that he will visit other flats unless the rent falls.
He makes a conditional offer instead of a flat refusal.
He accepts 700 but asks to pay the deposit in parts.

feedback.es: Carlos no rechaza: alaba el departamento, explica su límite y condiciona el pago de la fianza. La propuesta del casero llega después, como respuesta.

origin.audio: When the landlord named a rent of 700, Carlos did not say no. He said that he liked the flat, that his budget was tight, and that he could pay the deposit immediately if the rent were 650. The landlord sighed, hesitated, and then mentioned a twelve-month contract.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la función que cumple en la situación.

pairs.es: Intercambio: doy algo a cambio de otra cosa

pairs: let me clarify what I meant

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función distinta: seguimiento, condición, intercambio y reparación.

prompt.es: Escribe al casero: preséntate, negocia con condiciones y repara un malentendido.

answer.text: Dear Mr Reid, Good morning. I am a newcomer to the city, and I am writing about the flat on Elm Street. I arrived last week, and I am looking for a quiet place near my new job. I have seen the photographs, and I would like to visit the flat this week if that is possible. I work as a translator, so I am at home during the day and I will look after the flat carefully. I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent is 650 a month instead of 700. In exchange for the lower rent, I would sign a twelve-month contract, and I could start on the first of next month. I think that would be a fair compromise for both of us, and I am sure we can reach an agreement that suits you. I also think there was a misunderstanding about the floor: I meant the second floor, not the first. Let me clarify this now so that we can avoid any problem later. Thank you very much for your patience, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos
accepted: Dear Mr Reid, Good morning. I am a newcomer to the city, and I am writing about the flat on Elm Street. I arrived last week, and I am looking for a quiet place near my new job. I have seen the photographs, and I would like to visit the flat this week if that is possible. I work as a translator, so I am at home during the day and I will look after the flat carefully. I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent is 650 a month instead of 700. In exchange for the lower rent, I would sign a twelve-month contract, and I could start on the first of next month. I think that would be a fair compromise for both of us, and I am sure we can reach an agreement that suits you. I also think there was a misunderstanding about the floor: I meant the second floor, not the first. Let me clarify this now so that we can avoid any problem later. Thank you very much for your patience, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos

Dear Mr Reid, I have just arrived in the city, so I am new to everything. I am interested in the flat on Elm Street, and I would like to visit it this week. I would pay the deposit today as long as the rent is 650 a month and not 700. In return, I can offer a twelve-month contract, and I can move in at the start of next month. I believe that would be a fair compromise. I also think there was a mix-up about the floor, because what I meant was the second floor. I would like to clarify this before we meet so that nobody is disappointed. Thank you for your time and your patience. Yours sincerely, Carlos

feedback.es: Un mensaje completo se presenta como recién llegado, ofrece con condición (provided that), propone un intercambio, repara sin culpar y cierra con cortesía.

origin.text: Acabas de llegar a una ciudad nueva. Escribe al casero, el señor Reid: preséntate como recién llegado; ofrece pagar la fianza ahora si el alquiler baja de 700 a 650; ofrece un contrato de doce meses a cambio; propón un compromiso justo; repara un malentendido: querías decir la segunda planta, no la primera; cierra con cortesía.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué revela la condición del casero sobre sus prioridades.

choices.text: He hopes she will refuse so that he can raise the rent.
He is mainly worried that the bills will not be paid.
He would rather have a stable tenant than a higher rent.

feedback.es: Acepta incluir las facturas a cambio de un año de contrato: prefiere estabilidad a un alquiler mayor. No rechaza nada ni menciona impagos.

origin.audio: The tenant said she would take the flat if the bills were included in the rent. The landlord replied that he could do that, but only if she signed for a year. She thought for a moment, asked whether the contract could be ended early in an emergency, and then agreed when he said that it could, provided that she gave two months' notice. He wrote the figures down carefully, and they agreed to meet on Monday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión corrige el registro sin perder lo que se quiere pedir?

choices.text: Good morning, Mr Reid. Would it be possible to move the viewing to another day? I would also like to discuss the rent.
Good morning, Mr Reid. I am afraid you will have to change the viewing, and the rent must go down.
Dear Mr Reid, I am so sorry to trouble you, but I cannot possibly come, and I will not mention the rent.

feedback.es: Mantiene las dos peticiones (cambiar la visita y hablar del alquiler) con fórmulas corteses. La segunda sigue siendo una orden y la tercera se disculpa tanto que renuncia a pedir.

origin.text: Message to the landlord: Hey. I can't come on Thursday, so change the viewing. And the rent you said is too high, fix it.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lograron cerrar un trato antes de que terminara la visita.»

feedback.es: Strike a deal es la colocación habitual para cerrar un acuerdo tras negociar; reach y make a deal también son naturales.

origin.text: After an hour of talks, the landlord lowered the rent and Carlos accepted a longer contract. It was not the price either of them wanted, but they managed to ___ a deal before the viewing ended.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué este modo de reparar el malentendido funciona.

choices.text: She shows that the agent made the mistake in the first place.
She accepts her share of the confusion and offers a practical solution.
She postpones the meeting until the agent has calmed down.

feedback.es: Reconoce su parte, repite el día correcto y ofrece una solución: repara sin culpar. No acusa al agente de oír mal ni aplaza nada.

origin.audio: Ana had told the agent that the keys would be ready on Friday. When he phoned on Friday morning, she realised that she had meant Thursday. Instead of defending herself, she apologised for the confusion, repeated the correct day, and offered to collect the keys herself that afternoon.

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender el casero con su última frase?

choices.text: That the landlord has already refused Carlos's offer.
That Carlos should decide quickly or risk losing the flat.
That twelve months is too long a contract for the landlord.
That the other visitors have offered a higher rent.

feedback.es: La mención de otras visitas y de un plazo hasta el viernes presiona con cortesía: decide pronto o podrías perder el departamento. No rechaza la oferta ni dice nada de otros alquileres.

origin.text: Dear Carlos, thank you for your offer. Twelve months is certainly something we can discuss, and I appreciate your quick reply. However, several other people have already visited the flat this week, so I would be grateful for a decision by Friday.

prompt.es: Propón un trato: «Acepto el contrato, siempre que el alquiler sea de 650.»

answer.text: I accept the contract provided that the rent is 650.
accepted: I accept the contract provided that the rent is 650.
I will accept the contract providing that the rent is 650.
I accept the contract as long as the rent is 650.

feedback.es: Provided that (o as long as) presenta la condición de tu aceptación, y el alquiler queda fijado en el presente simple.

origin.text: Acepto el contrato, siempre que el alquiler sea de 650.
